Name: Sebastian Beach Portrait Fix
Author: failedtaste
Description:
[center][size=4][b]Description:[/b][/size][/center]
[center][color=#D4D4D8][size=3]It bothered me that his beach portrait's shoulders was broader than his default/winter portraits, so I edited his beach portrait to be consistent with the others.[/size][/color][/center]
[center][size=3][font=Sans-serif]This feels like such a tiny thing that no one probably cared about, but it bothered [i]me[/i] so I used my *editing skills* to fix it, and instead of keeping it to myself I'll let others fix this if they want as well. I don't know if anyone else did this already and I didn't check. So if they did, sorry.[/font][/size][/center]
[center][line]
[/center]
[center][size=4][b]Requirements:[/b][/size][/center]
[center][b][color=#D4D4D8][size=3]- SMAPI[/size][/color][/b][/center]
[center][b][color=#D4D4D8][size=3]- Content Patcher[/size][/color][/b][/center]
[center][line]
[/center]
[center][b][color=#D4D4D8][size=4]Notes:[/size][/color][/b][/center]
[center][color=#D4D4D8][size=3]- If you want to make this compatible for something other than content patcher let me know and I can probably find a way to put that here. Will give credits to you as well.[/size][/color][/center]
[center][color=#D4D4D8][size=3]- If you wanna use the altered portrait assets in your mod go ahead, just credit me please.[/size][/color][/center]
[center][color=#D4D4D8][size=3]- I am new to modding/posting on nexus so I do not really know what I'm doing, if there's issues let me know.[/size][/color][/center]
[center][color=#D4D4D8][size=3]- if the pixels look uneven in the images that's because my art program did that when making the portraits bigger for the thumbnails. Everything should work in-game.[/size][/color][/center]
[center][color=#D4D4D8][size=3]- For installing just unzip into the mods folder like you would most other mods.[/size][/color][/center]
[center][line]
[/center]
[center][color=#D4D4D8][size=4][b]Credits:[/b][/size][/color][/center]
[center][color=#D4D4D8][size=3]- ConcernedApe (for creating the game.)[/size][/color][/center]
